plugins.name: merch
plugins.description: Search and discover branded merchandise from ethical suppliers. Find products by keyword, category, budget, color, and sustainability rating. Get detailed pricing breakdowns and decoration options.

skills.name: pricing
skills.description: Calculate and explain branded merchandise pricing including unit costs, decoration costs, and selling prices at different quantities. Use when the user asks to "price this", "how much would it cost", "get a quote", "pricing breakdown", or "compare prices at different quantities".
skills.description_zh: 计算解释品牌周边商品定价，拆分单位、印制装饰成本及不同采购数量下销售价，支持报价和数量比较。

skills.name: product-search
skills.description: Search for branded merchandise and promotional products from a catalog of 8,000+ items across multiple ethical suppliers. Use when the user asks to "find merch", "search for products", "recommend merchandise", "find branded items", or "suggest promotional products".
skills.description_zh: 从原说明所称8000余项、多家伦理供应商商品目录查找推荐品牌周边和促销产品。

skills.name: sustainability
skills.description: Explain sustainability ratings and help users find eco-friendly branded merchandise. Use when the user asks about "sustainability", "eco-friendly", "green products", "recycled", "ethical sourcing", or "environmental impact" of merchandise.
skills.description_zh: 解释商品可持续评级、环保与再生材料、伦理采购及环境影响，帮助寻找环保品牌周边。
